notes.title: January Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys! 

Hope you all had a lovely Christmas and are kicking 2018 off right. It's been a year since we had Miner Meltdown's first online alpha, and it's crazy to think how far the game has come since then.

A few things to announce:

On Feb 1, the initial "Potato Skin" launch skin will be making a temporary comeback! Play anytime in Feb to unlock this limited edition skin.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/7ee805c4482a12d58573125c3f396eb00f00fa80.png[/img]

Miner Meltdown's soundtrack produced by Bob Baffy is now available on our Steam page. [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/780830/Miner_Meltdown__Official_Soundtrack/]Check it out![/url] It's pretty darn catchy.

I've been working on a new game-mode! It's taking a bit longer than expected, but I'll hopefully have some details on that soon so sit tight! I may need some testers so be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/e6U4fbm]Discord community.[/url]

Also, We're 5 reviews short of hitting that magic 50 number. Reviews good or constructive are always appreciated!

Cheers!!
- James

notes.title: Progress Update since leaving Early Access + 1.1.0.6
notes.content:
Lots of updates since Miner Meltdown transitioned out of Early Access in August!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/a02d680d8bcd09423ff2fbb464115756dfddc344.gif[/img]
 
1.1.0.1
Trading cards added!
- Collect packs to earn some pretty cool badges, emoticons, and custom backgrounds. 
- There's also a new hot fix live that updated the default secondary weapon to work with left-control on the keyboard

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/3013b01453f638d48ae12af8cf8e9b78cac9311e.png[/img]

1.1.0.2
- Improved initial load time

..1.1.0.4:
- Mini-map upgrades: You can now see your teammates, chests that you've found, and merchants on the mini-map.
- You can also ping areas of the mini-map to alert your teammates.
- Also added an optional inverted controls toggle in the settings (it was requested so that up/down while roping can be reversed).
- Fixed a long standing bug where clicking the mini-map stops your weapon from firing!
- Leaderboards have been reset for the month! Hop in the top 10 early to grab that sexy leaberboard skin.

1.1.0.5:
fixed a rare but annoying bug where sometimes the server thinks your on the opposing team, and you cannot damage the enemy team or score points.

Hotfix 1.1.0.6 - Settings bug fix

Just put up a patch for a fix for a settings bug. If you changed your monitor after adjusting the settings, it could prevent you from loading up settings again.
Should be fixed up now!

notes.title: Mini-map beefed up, inverted controls, & more! (v1.1.0.4)
notes.content:
1.1.0.4 is live! Bringing in some new features.

- The long requested mini-map upgrades are here. You can now see your teammates, chests that you've found, and merchants on the mini-map.

- You can also ping areas of the mini-map to alert your teammates.

- Also added an optional inverted controls toggle in the settings (it was requested so that up/down while roping can be reversed).

- Fixed a long standing bug where clicking the mini-map stops your weapon from firing!

- Leaderboards have been reset for the month! Hop in the top 10 early to grab that sexy leaberboard skin.

Thanks for reading! As always, hit me up in the discord channel for your next round of feature requests.

And we're oh so close to getting 25 Steam reviews :) Any reviews would be greatly appreciated!

- James

notes.title: Miner Meltdown is Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/06d61d41edf7e44c6ea4489c0cd4d3cb7670a5a0.jpg[/img]
Today’s the day! Miner Meltdown has left Early Access and gone Full Release!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TPxTNB9cK_0]Launch Trailer[/url]

This launch update is without a doubt that biggest update yet, with the biggest new features being:
[list]
[*]New “Crazy King” game-type
[*]New Mutant Type: “The Cuddler”
[*]New Destructo-duck weapon
[*]Arrow Traps
[*]51 New Achievements
[*]Adjustable Bot Difficulties
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/f7d7357040b7b6f92bf825c813628805bb5b3c6e.gif[/img]

There’s also a giant pile of fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*]Smarter bots – No longer stop moving randomly, don’t twitch around bumps, don’t get stuck on chests
[*]Maps randomized when starting lobby
[*]Shorter default game times
[*]Sword hitbox increased to reach enemies below the player
[*]Added Page numbers to shop, to make it more obvious that there’s a second page
[*]Increased assault rifle damage
[*]Lowered Jetpack cost, players start with 25 gold
[*]Faster level loading
[*]Fix for: host can’t quit after player quits
[*]Fix for: all players have the same voice
[*]Fix for: hanging dead lobby
[*]Fix for: floating dynamite
[*]Fix for: bots pickaxe way too fast
[*]Fix for: occasional hanging when it fails to load a match
[*]Fix for: people not on leaderboard have access to leaderboard skin
[*]Fix for: if players quits while under door, it stays open
[*]Fix for: Drill arm occasionally not extending on client
[*]Fix for: annoying merchant “swoosh” sounds while walking by him
[*]Fixed tileset for entrance
[*]Fix for: occasionally can’t equip with number keys
[*]Fix for screen gets stuck shaking while drilling occasionally
[*]Fix for: occasionally can’t equip item in inventory
[*]Fix for: getting a daily bonus while in tutorial looks borked
[/list]

It’s been a wild 2 years, and I’m so thankful for all of the support helping get to this point!
See you in the mines!
– James

notes.title: Teleporter update live! (1.0.3.1)
notes.content:
Hey all. 1.0.3.1 is officially live!
The sexy portion of this update is the snazzy new teleporter weapon, but it's also packed with a big pile of bug fixes and stability improvements. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/1b32afbcb004987f8e9031e840f918facad4740b.gif[/img]

Full patch notes below:

[h1] Major Updates [/h1]
[list]
 [*]Teleporter added
 [*]Weapon unlocks based on level
 [*]Bullet shell particle effects added
 [*]Player / gut-buster explosion effects beefed up
[/list]


[h1] Bug fixes [/h1]
[list]
 [*]Fixed infinite rope-jumping exploit.
 [*]Fixed occasional black screen on load.
 [*]Fixed occasional friendly fire issues
 [*]Gold / diamonds less laggy, no longer float in mid-air
 [*]Fixed issues caused when 2 new users join a match in progress simultaneously
 [*]Bots no longer flicker when directly above target
 [*]Fixed cart noise sometimes doesn't work
 [*]Fixed diamond dash drop-off occasionally missing
 [*]Fixed can't drop the drill with the e button.
 [*]Much less likely to fall through the map.
 [*]Number keys working after respawning
 [*]Teammate colors fixed in the chat
 [*]Lowered screen-shake radius
 [*]Progress Bar no longer goes past the end on max-level
[/list]

[h1] Balancing Changes [/h1]
[list]
 [*] Bots accuracy and reaction time improved
 [*] Flamethrower damage increased
 [*] Lightning Gun damage increased
 [*] Bots can use Blaster
[/list]

Thanks for reading! Don't forget to [url=https://discord.gg/e6U4fbm]join the Discord[/url] to let me know what you want to see added to the game.

notes.title: Miner Meltdown Easter Update (1.0.2.0) is here!
notes.content:
The [b]Miner Meltdown Easter Update (1.0.2.0) [/b]is upon us!
Which means that you get new weapons, a new game-type, a limited edition skin, and more!

[h1]New Weapons[/h1]
You voted, and the newest weapons joining the arsenal are the medic gun, and the alien blaster. Go try em' out.  
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/fa8242b7327d941414488ecac181e5ea3b2af091.png[/img]     [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/a18a63913139a27698f5507cb0f35295efa982a4.png[/img]    

[h1]New Game Type![/h1]
Miner Meltdown has a brand new game-type: [b]Diamond Dash.[/b]
- Collect diamonds and bring them to the central drop-off zone to score points. But be careful, if you get killed, your enemies will pick up all of the diamonds that you dropped.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/e7271d7cb74bd72354a41257ff9afbf2bc84730f.png[/img]

[h1]Limited Edition Easter Skin![/h1]
Play anytime before Easter, and you'll have a chance at unlocking the limited edition Bunny Miner.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/9a81e768505098b962aa4ff45a7c817be5c8e01d.png[/img]

[h1]"Kill The Dev" Achievement Added![/h1]
If you see this guy hopping in/out of your games, then that would be me. Manage to blow me up and you'll unlock a special achievement.
I will be streaming Monday (April 10) at 7-9pm (EST) if you're looking to find me! [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mighty_pebble]https://www.twitch.tv/mighty_pebble[/url]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/6e740f029abda2057e5f01c7487d5ac4a7e50c83.png[/img]

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added medic gun and alien blaster
[*]Added Diamond Dash game-type
[*]Added limited seasonal bunny skin
[*]Added achievement for killing the dev, and a custom dev skin
[*]Instructions animate at the start of a match
[*]Toned down fall damage
[*]Reduced chance of over-powered chest drops
[*]Bot improvements to avoid fall damage, and chase loose minerals
[*]Fixed bug where bots are too powerful with lighting gun
[*]Fixed bug where your character keeps moving after clicking out/in window
[*]Fixed glow-sticks not always lightning up bug
[*]Improved joining in progress occasional issues
[/list]

Don't forget to  [url=https://discord.gg/e6U4fbm]join the Discord community[/url] to give your feedback on which weapons, game-types, features, or anything at all that you'd like to see added next

notes.title: 1.0.1.0 is here! Multiplayer bots and more.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/4a1e486fba51e4b69190ed8ae3cd61e4d0325ab4.jpg[/img]

Hey guys! Just released v.1.0.1.0. The update mainly brings bots to multiplayer matches but also comes with a big pile of improvements.

[h1]Features / balacing[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Optional multiplayer bots
    [*]Rocket Launcher splash damage reduced
    [*]Bots shooting slower, less accurately 
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed some joining in progress issues
    [*]Fixed invisible players/mutants
    [*]Improved bandwidth load
    [*]Bots not getting stuck as frequently
    [*]Achievements working for pistol and assault rifle
    [*]UI issues on joining lobby
    [*]Fix for score resetting when quitting & rejoining a match
    [*]Bots now have randomized voices
    [*]Fix for chests always appear closed when joining match in progress
[/list]

Next up is some fun stuff! Going to be adding some new weapons to the arsenal within the next few weeks.

I've set up a discord channel, where we will be organizing play sessions, and you can also harass me for any new feature requests or bug reports that you have.
[url=https://discord.gg/e6U4fbm] Miner Meltdown Discord[/url]

Thanks for reading!
- James
